revised_prompt: Generate a detailed 16-bit pixel art illustration in a wide landscape composition, approximately 16:9. Crisp hard pixel edges, intentional pixel clusters, no antialiasing or blur. Warm muted retro palette: teal, warm grey, navy, cream, with orange accents; no purple neon. Funny satirical editorial news-illustration mood. Scene: an enormous wall made of hundreds of small phone screens arranged in a dense regular grid extending across the composition. Every single screen shows the EXACT SAME orange cat, identical portrait and pose, with one speech bubble containing ONLY a single round dot. Many creators stand in front of the phones, each filming the same cat content with a phone or tiny camera, repetitive copycat behavior, expressive humorous silhouettes and poses; use layered tiers and perspective so the huge scale and rows of phones remain clear. On top of the wall sits the actual orange cat, visibly bored, half-lidded eyes, slumped posture and dangling tail, ignored and unpaid while everybody copies its image. Convey this visually through staging and expression, with no labels. Clear focal point on the real cat, readable repeated cat portraits and the crowd, rich pixel-art environmental detail. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO LOGOS, NO WATERMARKS, NO signatures, NO interface text anywhere. The only mark within speech bubbles is a single dot, never ellipses. Background must be completely opaque and fill the entire rectangular canvas edge to edge with warm cream paper-like pixel texture or fully rendered muted scenery. No transparency, cutouts, empty alpha areas, black corner regions, black border, or vignette.
